hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: For every character shared between strings s and t, determine its position in each string.

hints.title: Position Mapping
hints.text: Store the index of each character from s in a lookup table.

hints.title: Summation
hints.text: Iterate through t, computing the absolute difference between the index in s and current index in t, and sum the results.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: length of strings s and t
complexity.notes: Single pass position lookup over 26 characters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single scan is already minimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space for 26-character index array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use character indexing to compute position differences in linear time.
